lines.en: I am an idol. I do not walk.

lines.zh: 台座钉在地上，我也钉着。
lines.en: The plinth is fixed, and so am I.
I have held this hand raised for years.
Someone walked past me.
I cast my shadow down the corridor.

lines.zh: 你看见的是我，不是我走过来。
lines.en: What you see is me, not me approaching.

lines.zh: 风从门缝进来，我的白布动了。
lines.en: Wind through the door stirs my cloth.
I am still; you are the one circling.
Only one lamp in this corridor.

lines.zh: 下面没有地板，我也不会掉下去。
lines.en: The floor is absent, and I still do not fall.
My stance is always the same.
I stand close against the wall.
I hang like a garment.

lines.zh: 我的空洞眼睛对着门口。
lines.en: My hollow eyes face the door.
A crack in the paint.
Someone arranged this pose for me.
The tube hums, very softly.

lines.zh: 我不需要看也知道你在。
lines.en: I know you are here without looking.
My fingertips are sharp.
What lies behind this wall?
The night is long. I do not sleep.
Do not look too long.
You suit this room.

lines.zh: 我手上没有线，可我被吊着。
lines.en: No strings, yet I am suspended.
I am not for photographs.
This face was painted on.
That small light of yours offends me.
There is nothing behind you.
My plinth is beneath you.
Paint chipped. The stone is unharmed.
I neither cry out nor move.
Dust settles on the plinth.
That blow left no echo.
My hand is still raised.
My face has not changed.

lines.zh: 你打的是装饰，不是要害。
lines.en: You struck ornament, not vitals.
The crack has deepened.
There is no need for me to dodge.
I am still standing here.

lines.zh: 供品放我脚边，我也咬不动。
lines.en: Leave offerings at my feet; I cannot bite.
Set it on the plinth.
I am not hungry. I am waiting.
That is no use to an idol.
Take it away.
I have no mouth to speak of.
Further away.
It will rot beside me.
Thank you, but no.
Leave it for the living.

lines.zh: 你撞上石座，我连灰都没落。
lines.en: You hit my pedestal; not a speck of dust falls.
That plinth must have caught your knee.
Not even dust fell.
Go around.

lines.zh: 你把我的布扯偏了一角。
lines.en: You pulled my cloth askew.
I am not a thing to push.
The pain is yours.
I have been here many years.
Stay an arm's length away.
I am decoration.
I have no feelings to speak of.
Do not say such things to an idol.
My lips are carved.
I am silent.
Leave that question to the living.
I do not answer.
I am here, watching.
Say no more.
It fell beside the plinth.
Someone will come for it.
It rests against my foot.
I cannot bend.
Dust gathers on it slowly.
This floor should not hold things.
It belongs to the room now.
You want it too?
It is no longer where it was.

lines.zh: 猎物走过，我的眼珠不能转。
lines.en: Prey passes; my stone eyes cannot turn.
Put the weapon down.
I only stand here.
This image is sturdy.
You would take me apart?
There is nothing to take from me.
You only need to walk past.
I will keep watching.
Go ahead.
You cannot break stone.
Stone lies beneath this paint.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，可石头不听话。
lines.en: I see you, but stone will not obey.
Do not expect me to blink.
My gaze cannot move.
You stand before my face.
You have circled to my side.

lines.zh: 石耳朵贴着地，听得很清楚。
lines.en: My stone ear against the floor hears clearly.
How does one fight an idol?
I have no weakness to find.

lines.zh: 灯一灭，我的影子长了一截。
lines.en: The light dies, and my shadow grows.
The plinth nearly tripped you.
I have no breathing to disturb.
The closer you come, the clearer I am.
You still have a way out.
I watch you. I keep watching.
There is nothing here to take.
You should not have entered this room.
I will stand here a long while.
Do not look behind me.
Your blade bites stone.
Sparks fly off my shoulder.
I have no arm to swing.
My fingertips were carved.

lines.zh: 你砍了三下，我纹丝不动。
lines.en: Three blows, and I have not moved.
That one numbed your own hand.
Another flake of paint.
I am here. You cannot move me.
Ten points is enough to stand.

lines.zh: 我的牙露在外面，只是装饰。
lines.en: My teeth show, but only as ornament.
The recoil pushes you off.
A new mark on the plinth.
My head did not turn.
You are tired.
I am still here.
The wall speaks for me.
This image will not fall.
Stop.
You looked up and saw me.
I hang deep in the corridor.
When the door opened, I was there.
I did not just arrive.
The light slides across my face.

lines.zh: 有人在我脚下放了东西。
lines.en: Someone left something at my feet.
This room has been empty a long while.
I have always watched the door.
You are still in the doorway.
Dust is my only company.
I wait for you to pass.

lines.zh: 火把漆烧黑了，石头不怕。
lines.en: Fire blackens the paint. Stone does not care.

lines.zh: 我从台座掉下去，碎了一角。
lines.en: I fall from the plinth and lose a corner.

lines.zh: 水流到我脚边，过不来了。
lines.en: Water reaches my feet and goes no further.
The blast rocks me once.

lines.zh: 一颗子弹留在我的肩里。
lines.en: A bullet stays in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 光在我身上绕，没有用处。
lines.en: Light coils on me. Useless.
Stone does not starve.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，白了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; everything goes white.
The plinth is gone, and so am I.
